defense_news.title: US Navy destroyer spent 4 days without power in South China Sea
defense_news.summary: USS Benfold endured an "engineering casualty" last month, leaving about 300 sailors without potable water, galley services, toilets or air conditioning.

defense_news.title: US, South Korea to cut length, scope of military drills after Trump order
defense_news.summary: The U.S. and South Korea will cut short their annual joint military drills and scale back field training after Trump ordered a reduction in participation.

defense_news.title: DARPA came close to finding a drone that can lift four times its own weight
defense_news.summary: In its recent Lift Challenge, DARPA came close to finding a drone that could lift four times its own weight.

defense_news.title: How US military funding propelled China’s robot dogs
defense_news.summary: Chinese company Unitree Robotics based the designs for its most successful robot dogs on innovations fueled by the U.S. military.
